blocks.content: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is India’s premier investigative agency responsible for handling high-profile corruption cases, economic offenses, special crimes, and inter-state investigations.

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is India’s premier investigative agency responsible for handling high-profile corruption cases, economic offenses, special crimes, and inter-state investigations.

items: CBI is designated as India's premier agency for high-profile investigative cases.
Key functional domains of the CBI include corruption, economic offenses, special crimes, and inter-state cases.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CBI serves as India's premier investigative agency.
It is responsible for probing high-profile corruption cases and economic offenses.
Its investigative scope covers special crimes as well as inter-state matters.
